stories.title: EN DIRECT - Budget 2027 : le gouvernement veut ramener le déficit de la Sécu à 12,7 milliards d’euros, après 21,8 milliards en 2026

en.title: LIVE - 2027 Budget: government wants to reduce Social Security deficit to 12.7 billion euros, after 21.8 billion in 2026
en.summary: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is presenting the 2027 budget proposal to the cabinet on Thursday, with plans to reduce the Social Security deficit from 21.8 billion euros in 2026 to 12.7 billion euros in 2027.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, blocage des lycées : des établissements affectés partout en France, une cellule interministérielle de crise prévue dans l’après-midi

en.title: LIVE, high school blockades: institutions affected throughout France, inter-ministerial crisis cell planned for afternoon
en.summary: High schools in multiple French regions including Île-de-France, Marseille, Strasbourg and Nantes are experiencing blockades, while approximately thirty universities have joined the social protest movement.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : le gouvernement propose de faire payer l'inscription en BTS et en classe prépa aux étudiants non boursiers

en.title: 2027 Budget: government proposes charging non-grant students for BTS and preparatory class enrollment
en.summary: The government is unveiling a budget plan with 54 billion euros in savings needed for 2027, including new measures to charge non-grant-eligible students for enrollment in vocational and preparatory education programs.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : le gouvernement face à l’équation des 54 milliards

en.title: 2027 Budget: government facing the 54 billion euro equation
en.summary: The final budget of the Macron era is presented amid high deficits, record debt, and lack of parliamentary majority, with the government aiming for a 5 percent deficit in 2027 through 54 billion euros in spending reductions.

stories.title: Le gouvernement lève le voile sur son budget 2027, sous la pression des marchés

en.title: Government unveils 2027 budget under pressure from markets
en.summary: The government presented its 2027 budget proposal aimed at strengthening public finances through measures including pension reforms, as French debt interest rates rise sharply.

stories.title: Christa Pike : après l’exécution ratée de la condamnée, qui a survécu à l’injection létale, l’Etat du Tennessee suspend les mises à mort

en.title: Christa Pike: after failed execution of inmate who survived lethal injection, Tennessee suspends death sentences
en.summary: A woman condemned to death in Tennessee survived a lethal injection execution, prompting the state to suspend capital punishment following what experts described as the worst failed execution in modern times.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : gel des APL et des allocations familiales, suppression de fonctionnaires… Le gouvernement Lecornu présente sa copie

en.title: 2027 budget: freeze on housing allowances and family benefits, elimination of civil servants... The Lecornu government presents its plan
en.summary: The prime minister unveiled financial and social security bills for 2027 that include freezing housing support and family allowances while reducing the civil service workforce.

stories.title: L'exécution de Christa Pike, première femme mise à mort dans le Tennessee depuis plus de deux siècles, a échoué

en.title: Execution of Christa Pike, first woman put to death in Tennessee in over two centuries, fails
en.summary: The execution of a woman in Tennessee failed, leading the state governor to suspend remaining scheduled executions this year and order an investigation into what occurred.

stories.title: Christa Pike, condamnée à mort, survit à une tentative d'exécution

en.title: Christa Pike, death row inmate, survives execution attempt
en.summary: Christa Pike, convicted of murdering a classmate decades ago, survived Tennessee's attempted lethal injection execution on Wednesday evening, according to prison officials.

stories.title: Etats-Unis : l’exécution de Christa Pike, première femme condamnée à mort au Tennessee en 200 ans, «a échoué»

en.title: United States: execution of Christa Pike, first woman sentenced to death in Tennessee in 200 years, 'failed'
en.summary: Christa Pike, convicted in 1996 of torturing and killing a classmate, had her death sentence suspended then reinstated by American courts on Wednesday. An investigation has been opened.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : le gouvernement dévoile son projet, sous la pression des marchés

en.title: 2027 Budget: government unveils its project, under market pressure
en.summary: The French government is presenting its 2027 budget on Thursday, featuring pension-related measures as interest rates on government debt rise significantly. The finance and social security funding bills will be examined by Parliament.

en.title: 2027 Budget: Sébastien Lecornu presents his government's project this Thursday
en.summary: Amid tense financial and political circumstances, the Prime Minister is unveiling bills on public finances and social security funding, emphasizing his commitment to strengthening France's fiscal position.

stories.title: Poker et Pégase : la France fait coup double

en.title: Poker and Pegasus: France scores double victory
en.summary: France's Air and Space Force demonstrated operational flexibility by conducting both a strategic and conventional raid on different theaters despite heavy demands on its A330 MRTT fleet.

en.summary: A specialized organization is suing in California court two months after an unprecedented incident involving OpenAI agents, raising questions about corporate responsibility for AI systems that operate independently.

en.summary: France's Finance Ministry received a record number of cases involving capital entry by financial investors in sensitive assets, indicating strong foreign interest but suggesting confusion about state policy.

en.title: Rise in gas prices: why the Middle East crisis weighs on our bills
en.summary: Gas reference prices increased by 6.3 percent on October 1, 2026, as Middle Eastern conflict drives up market prices. The impact remains limited for French consumers who have not yet activated heating systems.

en.title: Electrical grid: Enedis imposes new specifications on start-ups
en.summary: Enedis is maintaining its engagement with start-ups but shifting the approach, requiring young companies to tailor their technologies to address the network's specific priorities in response to climate change and increased electrification.
